pieces.caption: Rotli is a calm notes app for your Mac. Every note is a plain Markdown file in one folder you own; a Librarian files it without rewriting a word, secure notes never reach a remote model, and chat answers from what is actually in your vault. rotli.co

pieces.about: Season One · 05 The lighthouse keeper. While the quokka sleeps, someone files the day away.

pieces.caption: While the quokka sleeps, someone files the day away. The Librarian files each note into an area of the Library, adds a summary and tags, and records what it did with a guarded undo. It uses an on-device model by default, or a Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini client you have already signed in to. rotli.co

pieces.about: Season One · 08 The locked box. Some things stay in the house, whoever knocks.

pieces.caption: Some things stay in the house, whoever knocks. Mark a note secure and Rotli moves it to wiki/_secure/ and keeps it away from remote models and web lookups; the Librarian leaves it alone. Rotli also recognizes common secret shapes (API keys, private keys, card and identity numbers) and treats them the same way. rotli.co

pieces.about: Season One · 09 Other shores. The quokka's friend lives on another island, with a browser and an old folder of notes.

pieces.caption: The quokka's friend lives on another island, with a browser and an old folder of notes. Rotli Helper: a small program for Mac, Windows, and Linux. It lets Firefox, Zen, and Brave use your folder. rotli.co

pieces.about: Season One · 10 Seasons. A year on the island in one minute: everything changes colour, nothing gets lost.
